title: YNZDRWA 8 Pack Sanding Sponge, Washable and Reusable Sanding Blocks for Drywall Wood Metal Furniture, 60/80/120/220 Grit Sandpaper Block Assortment

reviews.title: Handy sanding sponges with good grip
reviews.body: These YNZDRWA sanding sponges have been great to keep around for small projects. I like having the different grits in one pack because I can start rough and then smooth things out without hunting for another sanding block. They fit nicely in my hand, have a good grip, and are easy to use on edges, corners, and flatter surfaces. The scrubbing power has been solid for wood and quick touch-up work, but they still have enough give that they do not feel awkward to control. I also like that they can be rinsed off and reused, which makes the pack feel like a good value. Overall the quality has been good and they have been very convenient.Read moreRead less

reviews.title: High-quality Firm Sponge Sanding Blocks
reviews.body: This 8 Pack of firm sponge sanding blocks is a great value for many sanding purposes. I have used them on rubber and wood and I even used them to remove a bit of paint from steel.The spong-like material that constitutes the sanding block is firm and durable. The sandpaper element is also durable.Some hard/deep sanding tasks require a hard sanding block, but, for most tasks, these firm-sponge blocks are superior.I am more than satisfied with this useful product. One purchase of this 8 Pack and you will be properly equipped for lots of comfortable, efficient,  hand-sanding.Read moreRead less

reviews.title: Overall, a great bargain for quick jobs
reviews.body: They’re a bit stiff and abrasive, and mine made a squeaking noise that reminded me of nails on a chalkboard 🙃—but they definitely get the job done if you’re looking for “one-and-done” style sanders. They work well, just don’t expect the durability or soft cushion feel you’d get from larger name-brand options. They’re slightly small and boxy, but still easy to handle and hold up fine for a few uses.Read moreRead less

features: 【ASSORTED GRIT SANDING BLOCKS】Includes 8 sanding blocks in 4 grits, from coarse to superfine specifications in 60/80/120/180/220 grit, 2 blocks for each grit. You can cut it into appropriate sizes for your needs

【HIGH-QUALITY MATERIALS】The sanding sponge are made of industrial-grade brown corundum with special electrostatic sand planting process. which is strong and durable, not easy to tear, making it versatile for a range of hand sanding needs

【WASHABLE AND REUSABLE】The drywall sanding blocks are designed for wet and dry dual-use, also can be used straight away or applied wet to the surface of an object for polishing, it can reduce flushing and improve work efficiency

【EASY TO IDENTIFY】Grit numbers are printed directly on the sanding sponge for quick selection, there are four different colors, including gray (corresponding to grit size - 220), blue (120), green (80) and orange (60), with different numbers of grains for different colors

【MULTI-PURPOSE】The sanding sponge are Ideal for polishing flat and irregular surfaces, suitable for any home renovation project - drywall, woodworking, putty sanding, furniture finishing, metal polishing and other polishing,etc
